tools.name: crm_login_password
tools.description: Authenticate against the CRM backend using an email+password or phone+password combination. REQUIRED before any other crm_* tool will work — there is no other way to obtain a session. If you (the AI assistant) don't already have these credentials in the conversation, ASK THE USER for their email/phone and password directly — never invent, guess, or reuse credentials from anywhere else. On success, stores the session token in memory for this server process only (nothing is persisted to disk or config). If the account belongs to exactly one organization it is auto-selected; otherwise call crm_list_organizations / crm_select_organization next.

identifier.description: Email address, or phone number if not using email login

countryCode.description: Only used when identifier is a phone number

tools.name: crm_login_request_otp
tools.description: Sends a one-time password to the given phone number to begin OTP-based login — the alternative to crm_login_password. ASK THE USER for their phone number directly; don't guess or reuse one from elsewhere in the conversation. Follow with crm_login_verify_otp once the user tells you the code they received.

tools.name: crm_login_verify_otp
tools.description: Completes OTP login. Pass the SAME phone/countryCode used in crm_login_request_otp so the phone normalization matches what the backend expects. On success, stores the session token like crm_login_password.

tools.name: crm_list_organizations
tools.description: Lists the organizations (tenants) the current session has access to. Use crm_select_organization to pick one.

tools.name: crm_select_organization
tools.description: Sets which organization (tenant/client) subsequent crm_* calls operate against, and fetches its details.

tools.name: crm_session_status
tools.description: Reports whether a token is set, which organization is active, and which user is logged in (token itself is masked).

tools.name: crm_logout
tools.description: Calls the backend logout endpoint (if a token is set) and clears the local session.

tools.name: crm_leads_list
tools.description: Paginated lead search/list. Pass isDealFinalized:true to get "Deals" (the CRM has no separate deals endpoint — a Deal is just a lead with is_deal_finalized=true), or isWon/isLost for won/lost pipelines.

clientId.description: Override the active organization id (defaults to the one set via crm_select_organization)

tools.name: crm_leads_get
tools.description: Fetches full lead detail including commercials (price/gst/roi/finance), requirements, custom fields, and assignee.

clientId.description: Override the active organization id (defaults to the one set via crm_select_organization)

tools.name: crm_leads_create
tools.description: Creates leads via the bulk-create endpoint (used for both single and multi-lead creation). IMPORTANT: gender must be Title Case ('Male'/'Female'/'Other'), and status/source must be real UUIDs (omit them rather than sending empty strings) — the backend Postgres layer throws on both.

clientId.description: Override the active organization id (defaults to the one set via crm_select_organization)

assignedTo.description: User id the lead(s) will be assigned to

tools.name: crm_leads_update
tools.description: Partial update of a lead. Accepts the same basic fields as crm_leads_create plus commercial data (pricing/finance) and requirement data, and is_deal_finalized to mark it a Deal.

clientId.description: Override the active organization id (defaults to the one set via crm_select_organization)

fields.description: Raw update body sent as-is (after this tool applies field-name mapping is NOT done here — use snake_case backend field names directly, e.g. {"full_name":"...","status":"<uuid>","commercial_data":{...},"requirement_data":{...},"is_deal_finalized":true}). This is intentionally a passthrough since the update surface is large — call crm_leads_get first to see current field names.

tools.name: crm_leads_bulk_import
tools.description: Imports many pre-built lead objects in chunks of 50 (same endpoint as crm_leads_create, looped).

clientId.description: Override the active organization id (defaults to the one set via crm_select_organization)

leads.description: Array of raw lead objects using backend snake_case field names

tools.name: crm_config_get
tools.description: In the BoardView web app, the CRM Config screen (apiKey/webhookUrl/retryAttempts/notificationsEnabled) is a frontend-only placeholder with no real backend endpoint behind it — it returns hardcoded fake data there too. This tool exists so callers get a clear explanation instead of a confusing empty/fake result.
